decision_cruda.rationale: Radio and CMMS agree that LH-01 (Este E595-06, 4 h likely, range 3-5) and LH-05 (Central C538-03, 2 h likely, range 1.5-2.5) are down. CONFIRM-01 is not triggered, so no confirmation is needed. Este is loader-limited. Its trucks can haul about 73 t/h, but LH-03 alone mucks about 36 t/h, so the stockpile (171 t of 450) can absorb more ore. E595-06 is the richest face at 15.4 g/t, with 256 t of broken ore left, so I cover it. LH-08 is the cheapest source: development heading DS-C512-01 costs only 1.9 oz/h, against 4.0 oz/h for DS-E543-02 (LH-09). LH-07 would give up Norte stope ore of about 5.6 oz/h. LH-10 is in preventive maintenance until 11:00 (PM-01), so it can't be loaned now. LH-08 at 80 m mucks about 31 t/h, which is about 15.3 oz/h at 15.4 g/t. Travel is about 0.5 h. Over about 3.5 productive hours that is about 108 t, or about 53 oz. The development cost is about 4.6 h x 1.9 = 8.7 oz. Net is about +45 oz. I do not cover Central C538-03. Central is truck-limited: the remaining loaders (LH-02, LH-04, LH-06) muck about 120 t/h against about 91 t/h of truck capacity, and the stockpile (264 t of 450) is already filling. A loan there would add almost nothing. A second loan to E595-06 is also not worth it, because the remaining ore would be exhausted anyway once LH-01 returns. No reserves are activated, because no stope has been stopped.
